# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-16 (W4 expanded: +11 papers from literature scan; +15 papers from Related Work survey; +17 papers from Related Work expansion; +16 papers from Related Work extension scan; +15 papers from 2026-05-16 incremental scan; +9 papers from Related Work targeted expansion; +6 papers from evidence cost literature scan; +11 papers from related work foundational survey)

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      两步机制：(1) 离线采样 baseline response；(2) 用 baseline 计算 contrastive reward
      作为 PPO 的 penalty 项。效果：惩罚 reward uncertainty、根据任务难度自适应校准、
      减少 PPO 中的 variance。在 TL;DR 和 HH-RLHF 上持续优于标准 RLHF。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。关键差异：(1) 它是对 learned RM 输出的后处理对比，
      CED 是 reward function 本身就是对比判别（evidence vs. corrupted evidence）；
      (2) 它在 PPO 中验证，CED 在 GRPO 中验证；
      (3) 它是 domain-agnostic penalty，CED 是 task-specific faithfulness signal。
      stabilizing 机制相通但实现路径根本不同。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，媲美 GPT-4o。
      Reward 设计：format reward (+1/-3) + metric reward (+2/-1.5)，先验证格式再加准确度。
      triplet extraction 用 F1-based reward（entity weight=1, triplet weight=3）。
      未报告 catastrophic forgetting——GRPO 训练后在 MATH-500/IFEval/GPQA 上性能不降反升，
      说明句子级 RE 的简单 reward 结构足以稳定 GRPO 训练。
    results:
      sem2010_in_domain: 91.8
      sem2010_ood: 66.5
      mdkg_in_domain: 88.1
      mdkg_ood: 65.8
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。关键差异与讨论：
      (1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，GRPO 成功；我们是文档级 RE，GRPO 失败→RSFT 成功。
      句子级 RE 每个 sample 只有 1 个 triple（binary classification），reward variance 天然充足；
      文档级 RE 每个 sample 有数十个 triple，F1 score 作为 reward 在 group 内趋于同质化（frac_zero_std→0.8）。

  - title: "Correctness is not Faithfulness in RAG Attributions"
    authors: Wallat, Heuss, de Rijke, Anand

    category: faithfulness_accuracy_tradeoff

      同时不牺牲 RE accuracy。

  # === Category 13: Evidence-Grounded RL (NEW - 2026-05-15 scan) ===

  - title: "EvidenceRL: Reinforcing Evidence Consistency for Trustworthy Language Models"
    authors: Ben Tamo, Lu, Marteau, Nnamdi, Wang
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.19532
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19532
    category: evidence_grounded_rl
    role: closest_competitor
    key_finding: >
      用 GRPO 同时优化 grounding（evidence entailment）和 correctness（答案准确性）。
      在 cardiac diagnosis（Llama-3.2-3B）上 F1@3 从 37.0→54.5，grounding 从 47.6→78.2，
      hallucination 降 5 倍。在 legal reasoning（Llama-3.1-8B）上 faithfulness 从 32.8%→67.6%。
      核心：证据一致性 reward 不牺牲 task accuracy 的前提下大幅提升 faithfulness。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      **最直接的 novelty 威胁。** EvidenceRL 与 FREIGE 共享核心 idea：用 GRPO + evidence faithfulness reward
      训练更可靠的模型。关键差异：(1) EvidenceRL 在 QA 域（cardiac/legal），不涉及 DocRE 的 structured output；
      (2) EvidenceRL 未报告 evidence generation 的 performance cost（evidence tax）——它的 grounding 和
      correctness 同时提升，而我们发现 DocRE 中两者存在 ~8pp 张力；
      (3) EvidenceRL 不涉及 task decoupling 现象（QLoRA-specific）；
      (4) EvidenceRL 无 inference-time reranking（CED reranker）。
      定位策略：EvidenceRL 证明 evidence-grounded RL 在 QA 域有效，
      我们揭示 DocRE structured output 带来的独特挑战（evidence tax、task decoupling）和解法（CED reranker）。

  # === Category 14: Multi-Objective GRPO (NEW - 2026-05-15 scan) ===

  - title: "MO-GRPO: Mitigating Reward Hacking of Group Relative Policy Optimization on Multi-Objective Problems"
    authors: Ichihara, Jinnai, Morimura, Sakamoto, Mitsuhashi, Uchibe
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2509.22047
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22047
    category: multi_objective_grpo
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 在多目标设置下易发生 reward hacking——只优化一个目标而牺牲其他目标。
      MO-GRPO 用 variance-based normalization 自动平衡多个 reward function 的权重，
      在多臂赌博机、控制、机器翻译、指令遵从四个域上实现稳定学习。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reward 本质是多目标（extraction F1 + evidence quality）。MO-GRPO 的分析
      解释了为什么单一 extraction F1 reward 下模型可能 hack 到 "忽略 evidence 只抽 triple" 的策略。
      CED 从 reward 设计端解决，MO-GRPO 从算法端解决，互补视角。

    authors: Bai, Liu, Zhuang, Zhou, Weng, Chen, Wang, Cai

      发现 Energy Loss Phenomenon：LLM 最后一层的 energy loss（L1 norm 差值）在 RL 训练中

    relevance_to_freige: >
      与 FREIGE Claim 4（EDCR 双层诊断工具）直接相关：energy loss 是另一种 representation-level
      diagnostic for reward hacking。EDCR 从 evidence-relation consistency 角度诊断，
      EPPO 从 hidden state energy 角度诊断——互补的诊断信号。
      FREIGE 可引用 EPPO 作为 "diagnostic signals for RL training health" 的同类工作。

      FlyLoRA 的解决方案（分配不同 rank 给不同任务）验证了 rank capacity 是 decoupling 的关键因素。

    category: knowledge_distillation_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      KD-DocRE：用 axial attention 学习 entity pair 间依赖关系，
      adaptive focal loss 解决类别不均衡，knowledge distillation 弥合
      人工标注和远程监督数据的差异。DocRED leaderboard 上超越前 SOTA 1.36 F1。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      KD 方法在 DocRE 中有效，暗示了 FREIGE 的 RSFT（rejection sampling fine-tuning）
      本质上也是一种 self-distillation——用模型自身的高质量输出训练自身。
      但 KD-DocRE 是 encoder-based discriminative，FREIGE 是 generative paradigm。

    year: 2024

    category: knowledge_distillation_docre
    role: related_method

      Self-distillation 思路与 FREIGE 的 RSFT 有共通之处——

    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.naacl-long.155/
    category: evaluation_generative_re

## Information Extraction vs. Relation Extraction

Information Extraction (IE) involves automatically converting unstructured textual content into structured data. Relation Extraction is the subtask of the Information Extraction task, which aims to identify relations between entities and assign them some kind of label or class.

## What is Relation Extraction?

Relation extraction is a fundamental information extraction task that seeks to detect and characterize semantic relationships between pairs of entities or events from natural language text. Relation extraction is a type of information extraction task that recognizes semantic relationships between entities in a sentence.

A relation is usually defined as triplet <entity1, relation_type, entity2>. For example, given the sentence "Barack Obama was the president of the USA.", Barack Obama is related to the USA as 'president'. A relation extractor aims at predicting the relationship of the 'president' between these two entities.

## Applications

Relation extraction provides important information for many NLP applications such as knowledge base population and question answering.

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about best-of-N sampling strategy and fine-tuning language models:

## Overview of Best-of-N Sampling

Best-of-N (BoN) is an inference strategy in which a verifier selects the best out of a set of LLM-generated responses. This strategy has shown strong empirical performance.

## Inference-Aware Fine-Tuning Approach

Recent research introduces a novel approach to fine-tuning language models specifically for Best-of-N sampling. This inference-aware fine-tuning paradigm fine-tunes the model in a manner that directly optimizes the performance of the inference-time strategy.

The approach devises the first imitation learning and reinforcement learning (RL) methods for BoN-aware fine-tuning, overcoming the challenging, non-differentiable argmax operator within BoN.

## Key Findings

BoN-aware models implicitly learn a meta-strategy that interleaves best responses with more diverse responses that might be better suited to a test-time input—a process reminiscent of the exploration-exploitation trade-off in RL.

## Empirical Results

The methods improve the BoN32 performance of Gemma 2B on Hendrycks MATH from 26.8% to 30.8%, and pass@32 from 60.0% to 67.0%, as well as the pass@16 on HumanEval from 61.6% to 67.1%.

This research addresses the mismatch between training and inference by aligning the fine-tuning process with how the model will actually be used during inference with multiple generation attempts.

## Key Findings

**Rejection Sampling Basics:**
A widely adopted method for constructing supervised reasoning data is rejection sampling, in which a teacher model generates multiple candidate trajectories for a given problem, retaining only those with correct final answers, then performs supervised fine-tuning on this filtered set of correct trajectories.

**Selection Strategies and Ablation Studies:**

Several recent papers conduct ablation studies on rejection sampling selection strategies:

1. **RS-DPO Method:** Ablation studies analyze the impact of reward model quality (RS-DPO is more robust to variations than PPO), threshold (η), and temperature (τ), where lowering the threshold generally improves performance but going too low can hurt it, and lower temperature increases sample size and enhances performance.

2. **General Ablation Findings:** Ablation studies reveal that performance in rejection sampling-based pipelines is sensitive to RS thresholds, temperature parameters, and reward model robustness.

3. **GRPO vs. Rejection Sampling:** A simple rejection sampling baseline (RAFT), which trains only on positively rewarded samples, yields competitive performance compared to GRPO and PPO, with ablation studies revealing that GRPO's main advantage arises from discarding prompts with entirely incorrect responses, rather than from its reward normalization.

**Hybrid Approaches:**
Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) is a suite of methods that augment and refine the supervised or reinforcement learning of large models by explicitly filtering, selecting, or synthesizing training examples according to correctness criteria, task-specific rejection signals, or alignment targets.

## Overview

Document-level Relation Extraction (RE) is a task aiming at identifying relations of multiple entity pairs in a document. Reinforcement learning has emerged as a valuable approach for addressing challenges in this domain.

## Key Applications of Reinforcement Learning

Several research directions use RL in document-level relation extraction:

1. **Evidence Sentence Selection**: Evidence sentence selection has been formulated as a sequential decision problem through a reinforcement learning mechanism, with efficient path searching strategies executed on document graphs to obtain promising sentences.

2. **N-ary Relation Extraction**: A reinforcement learning-based relation classifier training framework can adapt existing binary document-level relation extractors to handle complex relations, effectively reducing the impact of noise introduced by distant supervision or unrelated sentences.

3. **Cross-Document Extraction**: In cross-document relation extraction, reinforcement learning has been used to train input sentence selection modules, where relation prediction scores serve as rewards.

4. **Hierarchical Approaches**: Hierarchical reinforcement learning frameworks have been applied to enhance interaction between entity mentions and relation types, decomposing the extraction process into two-level RL policies for relation detection and entity extraction.

## Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning Overview

Rejection sampling is a technique for fine-tuning Large Language Models by incorporating human preferences. The process involves generating a list of N-best outputs, using a reward model to identify the highest-quality responses from this list, and then using this curated set of 'best' outputs as the data for fine-tuning the LLM.

## Key Differences

**Scored (Reward-Based) Selection:** Rejection sampling serves to select samples that has a high reward score in each iteration. By sampling multiple responses from a base model to a given prompt and subsequently selecting only those that surpass a predefined quality threshold, one can construct a refined, higher-quality dataset for a subsequent round of supervised fine-tuning.

**Random/Baseline Rejection Sampling:** A simple rejection sampling baseline, RAFT, which trains only on positively rewarded samples, yields competitive performance than GRPO and PPO. Recent research shows that even basic rejection sampling approaches that filter based on correctness can be surprisingly effective.

## Broader Context

Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) is a suite of methods that augment and refine supervised or reinforcement learning of large models by explicitly filtering, selecting, or synthesizing training examples according to correctness criteria, task-specific rejection signals, or alignment targets. RFT leverages rejection sampling, reward-based selection, and structured data augmentation to produce more reliable, robust, and generalizable models.

The research suggests that while scored/reward-based selection is the standard approach, simpler random or correctness-based rejection sampling can still be quite competitive for certain tasks.

## Overview of RAFT

RAFT is a family of fine-tuning techniques that ranks candidate outputs based on reward models to align generative models with specific external preferences. More specifically, RAFT iteratively generates n responses per prompt, filters out those with incorrect answers, and fine-tunes the LLM on the remaining accepted samples.

## RAFT vs. Rejection Sampling vs. Other Methods

Recent research has compared RAFT with other approaches. A simple rejection sampling baseline, RAFT, which trains only on positively rewarded samples, yields competitive performance than GRPO and PPO.

## Ablation Studies

The authors conduct ablation studies to address questions such as why RAFT++ converges faster initially but is eventually outperformed by GRPO, and analyze policy entropy, KL divergence, and training dynamics to understand the roles of positive and negative samples, reward normalization, and other techniques.

Key findings from ablation work include: GRPO's main advantage arises from discarding prompts with entirely incorrect responses, rather than from its reward normalization. As a result, Reinforce-Rej, a minimal policy gradient variant that filters both entirely incorrect and entirely correct samples, improves KL efficiency and entropy stability, highlighting the role of exploration in reward-based fine-tuning.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) and its applications:

## Overview of GRPO

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has garnered considerable attention due to its significant reduction in computational overhead and memory requirements. GRPO represents a major milestone for RL algorithms tailored to LLM reasoning, providing a highly effective solution by eliminating the critic network entirely and instead sampling multiple outputs for each prompt.

## Key Technical Developments (2024-2025)

GRPO was introduced in Shao et al., 2024 and used successfully to train DeepSeek-R1 models for promoting reasoning capabilities of LLMs using verifiable or binary rewards. GRPO is asymptotically equivalent to an oracle policy gradient algorithm and achieves asymptotically optimal performance within a broad class of policy gradient algorithms.

## Recent Extensions and Variants

Multi-Layer GRPO (MGRPO) adds an explicit self-correction layer where the first GRPO layer generates initial outputs while a secondary GRPO models self-correction via error detection and refinement. Tree-GRPO uses tree-structured rollouts to enable process-level preference estimation and finer credit assignment.

Group-relative Trajectory-based Policy Optimization (GTPO) addresses two issues of GRPO, gradient conflicts and policy collapse, through conflict-aware updates and entropy control.

Notably, the search results focus heavily on GRPO's applications to mathematical reasoning and coding tasks rather than Named Entity Recognition (NER) specifically, though the method is presented as a general post-training optimization approach for LLMs.

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json

with open('/tmp/lit_map_actual.json', 'r') as f:
    lit_map = json.load(f)

papers = lit_map['papers']

# ============================================================
# 4. Papers about learning curves or training dynamics of RL methods on NLP tasks
# ============================================================
print("=" * 80)
print("CATEGORY 4: Papers about learning curves / training dynamics of RL for NLP")
print("=" * 80)

keywords = ['learning curve', 'training dynamic', 'training dynamics', 'convergence', 
            'entropy collapse', 'mode collapse', 'reward hacking', 'training stability',
            'training instability', 'training collapse', 'gradient dynamics',
            'reward std', 'reward variance', 'advantage variance', 'frac_zero',
            'phase transition', 'early training', 'training progression']

results = []
for p in papers:
    all_text = json.dumps(p, ensure_ascii=False).lower()
    # Also require some RL or NLP context
    has_rl_context = any(kw in all_text for kw in ['grpo', 'reinforcement', 'rl ', 'ppo', 'rlhf', 'rlvr', 'policy optimization'])
    
    matched_kws = [kw for kw in keywords if kw in all_text]
    if matched_kws and has_rl_context:
        results.append((p, matched_kws))

for i, (p, kws) in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"\n--- Paper {i} ---")
    print(f"  Title: {p.get('title')}")
    print(f"  Venue: {p.get('venue')}")
    print(f"  Year: {p.get('year')}")
    print(f"  Role: {p.get('role')}")
    print(f"  Category: {p.get('category')}")
    print(f"  Matched keywords: {kws}")
    print(f"  Key finding: {p.get('key_finding', '')}")
    print(f"  Relevance: {p.get('relevance_to_ced_stabilizer', '')}")

print(f"\nTotal matches: {len(results)}")

PYEOF

content.content:
================================================================================
CATEGORY 4: Papers about learning curves / training dynamics of RL for NLP
================================================================================

--- Paper 1 ---
  Title: Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards
  Venue: arXiv 2511.03710
  Year: 2025
  Role: theoretical_support
  Category: reward_diversity
  Matched keywords: ['reward variance']
  Key finding: RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。 用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值， 构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。

  Relevance: 理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。 CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。


--- Paper 2 ---
  Title: Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF
  Venue: arXiv 2502.18770
  Year: 2025
  Role: background
  Category: reward_diversity
  Matched keywords: ['reward hacking']
  Key finding: RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则， 好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。

  Relevance: CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性， 且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。


--- Paper 3 ---
  Title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
  Venue: NeurIPS 2025
  Year: 2025
  Role: key_baseline
  Category: mode_collapse_prevention
  Matched keywords: ['entropy collapse', 'mode collapse', 'frac_zero']
  Key finding: Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。 根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08， 低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2） 为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。

  Relevance: DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面 防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance， 不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt 与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt 产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。


--- Paper 4 ---
  Title: Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO
  Venue: COLM 2025
  Year: 2025
  Role: related_analysis
  Category: mode_collapse_prevention
  Matched keywords: ['frac_zero']
  Key finding: GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组 （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号； (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。 当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。 Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。

  Relevance: 与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是 Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1， std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0， 从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。


--- Paper 5 ---
  Title: GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
  Venue: NeurIPS 2025
  Year: 2025
  Role: alternative_framework
  Category: mode_collapse_prevention
  Matched keywords: ['reward variance']
  Key finding: 将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重， variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。

  Relevance: GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似， 但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。


--- Paper 6 ---
  Title: DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO
  Venue: arXiv 2512.21514
  Year: 2025
  Role: parallel_work
  Category: mode_collapse_prevention
  Matched keywords: ['mode collapse']
  Key finding: 图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward） 和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。

  Relevance: 跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近—— 都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。


--- Paper 7 ---
  Title: Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients
  Venue: arXiv 2601.23135
  Year: 2025
  Role: theoretical_support
  Category: mode_collapse_prevention
  Matched keywords: ['reward std']
  Key finding: GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率， 收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。

  Relevance: 直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std， 从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

Here is the structured compilation of all relevant papers found across the five search queries.

---

## Category 1: Rejection Sampling / Selection Strategy Ablation

### 1.1 "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
- **Authors:** Liu et al.
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2504.11343, 2025
- **Key findings:** A simple rejection sampling baseline (RAFT) that trains only on positively rewarded samples yields competitive performance to GRPO and PPO. Ablation reveals GRPO's main advantage comes from discarding prompts with entirely incorrect responses, not from reward normalization. Introduces Reinforce-Rej, a minimal variant that filters both entirely correct and incorrect samples, improving KL efficiency and entropy stability.
- **Relevance:** Directly compares scored vs. filtered rejection sampling against RL methods, with detailed ablation on what makes selection matter.

### 1.2 "Scaling Relationship on Learning Mathematical Reasoning with Large Language Models" (RFT)
- **Authors:** Yuan et al.
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2308.01825, 2023 (ICLR-level impact)
- **Key findings:** The key factor in rejection sampling augmented data is the number of **distinct reasoning paths**, not just correctness. RFT augments datasets with multiple model-generated correct chains per example. On GSM8K, combining rejection samples from multiple models pushes LLaMA-7B from 35.9% (SFT) to 49.3% accuracy.
- **Relevance:** Foundational work showing that selection diversity/quality in rejection sampling dramatically impacts fine-tuning outcomes.

### 1.3 "RAFT: Reward rAnked FineTuning for Generative Foundation Model Alignment"
- **Authors:** Dong, Xiong et al.
- **Venue/Year:** Semantic Scholar / arXiv, 2023
- **Key findings:** RAFT iteratively generates n responses per prompt, filters out those with incorrect answers, and fine-tunes on accepted samples. Demonstrates that reward-ranked selection is a simple but effective alternative to full RL-based alignment.
- **Relevance:** Direct baseline for comparing scored selection (reward-ranked) vs. simpler filtering strategies.

### 1.4 "RS-DPO: A Hybrid Rejection Sampling and Direct Preference Optimization Method for Alignment of Large Language Models"
- **Authors:** Khaki et al.
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2402.10038, 2024
- **Key findings:** Ablation studies show RS-DPO is more robust to reward model quality variations than PPO. Performance is sensitive to rejection threshold (eta) and temperature (tau); lowering threshold generally improves performance but going too low hurts. Lower temperature increases sample size and enhances performance.
- **Relevance:** Detailed ablation on how selection threshold/scoring quality affects rejection sampling outcomes.

### 1.5 "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2602.04391, 2026
- **Key findings:** TrajFusion consistently outperforms standard RFT, particularly on challenging and long-form reasoning problems. Proposes fusing partial correct trajectories rather than only selecting complete correct ones.
- **Relevance:** Shows limitations of simple best-of-n selection and proposes improvements beyond binary accept/reject.

### 1.6 "RIFT: Repurposing Negative Samples via Reward-Informed Fine-Tuning"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2601.09253, 2026
- **Key findings:** Instead of discarding rejected samples, repurposes them via reward-informed training signals, extracting value from negative examples that standard rejection sampling throws away.
- **Relevance:** Addresses the waste inherent in rejection sampling by using scoring to inform training even on rejected samples.

---

## Category 2: Best-of-N Sampling Strategy

### 2.1 "Inference-Aware Fine-Tuning for Best-of-N Sampling in Large Language Models"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** ICLR 2025 (arXiv 2412.15287)
- **Key findings:** First imitation learning and RL methods for BoN-aware fine-tuning. BoN-aware models learn a meta-strategy interleaving best responses with diverse responses (exploration-exploitation trade-off). Improves Gemma 2B BoN32 on MATH from 26.8% to 30.8%, and pass@32 from 60.0% to 67.0%.
- **Relevance:** Shows that training strategy should be aware of the inference-time selection mechanism, directly relevant to how RSFT selection strategy interacts with training.

---

## Category 3: GRPO and RL for LLMs

### 3.1 "DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning"
- **Authors:** DeepSeek-AI
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2501.12948, 2025
- **Key findings:** Introduces GRPO for training reasoning LLMs with verifiable binary rewards. GRPO eliminates the critic network, instead estimating baselines from group scores. Combined with chain-of-thought format and strong pre-training, achieves state-of-the-art reasoning performance.
- **Relevance:** The foundational GRPO paper; critical reference for any GRPO-based training.

### 3.2 "Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards: GRPO's Effective Loss, Dynamics, and Success Amplification"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2503.06639, 2025
- **Key findings:** GRPO is asymptotically equivalent to an oracle policy gradient algorithm and achieves asymptotically optimal performance within a broad class of policy gradient algorithms. Provides theoretical grounding for GRPO's empirical success.
- **Relevance:** Theoretical analysis of why GRPO works, useful for justifying its use in IE tasks.

### 3.3 "GTPO: Stabilizing Group Relative Policy Optimization via Gradient and Entropy Control"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2508.03772, 2025
- **Key findings:** Addresses two issues with GRPO: gradient conflicts and policy collapse, through conflict-aware updates and entropy control. Proposes practical stabilization techniques.
- **Relevance:** Relevant if GRPO training shows instability on IE tasks.

### 3.4 "From Absolute to Relative: Rethinking Reward Shaping in Group-Based Reinforcement Learning"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2601.23058, 2026
- **Key findings:** Rethinks how rewards should be shaped in group-based RL settings like GRPO, comparing absolute vs. relative reward designs.
- **Relevance:** Relevant to CED-scored reward design choices in your RSFT pipeline.

---

## Category 4: RL for Document-Level Relation Extraction

### 4.1 "A Reinforcement Learning Framework for N-Ary Document-Level Relation Extraction"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** IEEE Xplore, 2024
- **Key findings:** RL-based relation classifier training framework adapts binary document-level RE to handle complex N-ary relations, reducing noise from distant supervision or irrelevant sentences.
- **Relevance:** Direct precedent for using RL in document-level relation extraction.

### 4.2 "DREEAM: Guiding Attention with Evidence for Improving Document-Level Relation Extraction"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2302.08675, 2023
- **Key findings:** Guides attention with evidence sentences to improve document-level RE. Uses evidence-aware mechanisms for better extraction.
- **Relevance:** Evidence-guided approach to DocRE, related to your "faith-evidence" project framing.

### 4.3 "Evidence-aware Document-level Relation Extraction"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** OpenReview (appears conference-submitted)
- **Key findings:** Explicitly models evidence awareness in document-level RE, connecting evidence identification with relation extraction.
- **Relevance:** Directly relevant to your project's evidence-aware IE approach.

### 4.4 "Reward-based Input Construction for Cross-document Relation Extraction"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2405.20649, 2024
- **Key findings:** Uses RL to train input sentence selection modules for cross-document RE, where relation prediction scores serve as rewards.
- **Relevance:** Uses reward/RL signals specifically for selecting inputs in relation extraction.

### 4.5 "A Hierarchical Framework for Relation Extraction with Reinforcement Learning"
- **Authors:** Takanobu et al.
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 1811.03925, 2018
- **Key findings:** Decomposes joint entity-relation extraction into two-level RL policies: high-level for relation detection, low-level for entity extraction. Pioneering work on RL for structured IE.
- **Relevance:** Early but foundational work on RL applied to joint extraction tasks.

### 4.6 "Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Planning: Harnessing Large Language Models for Complex Information Extraction"
- **Authors:** (Not specified in results)
- **Venue/Year:** arXiv 2406.11455, 2024
- **Key findings:** Divides extraction into classification of relations/events and extraction of entities in multiple orderly steps. Uses RL for adaptive planning in complex IE with LLMs.
- **Relevance:** Most directly relevant to your project: RL + LLM for information extraction, addressing false positives and missing elements.

---

## Summary of Key Gaps and Positioning

Based on these searches:

1. **Scored vs. random rejection sampling:** Paper 1.1 (Liu et al. 2025) and 1.2 (Yuan et al. 2023) are the closest comparisons, but neither tests on IE/RE tasks. Your 4.82pp gap (CED-scored vs random, k=1) would be a novel datapoint for structured extraction tasks.

2. **GRPO for IE:** No paper was found applying GRPO specifically to information extraction, NER, or relation extraction. All existing GRPO work targets math reasoning or coding. Your GRPO-for-IE results (ign_f1=0.4431 vs SFT 0.4057) appear to be a novel application.

3. **RL for DocRE:** Papers 4.1-4.6 show precedent for RL in document RE, but all use older RL formulations (not GRPO/PPO on LLMs). The combination of modern LLM-based GRPO with document-level IE is under-explored.

## 文献联动分析结果

### 一、literature_map 中已有的相关论文

**Rejection Sampling / Selection Strategy 相关（7篇核心）：**
- **RAFT** (TMLR 2024) — 经典 RSFT 框架：迭代 generate-rank-filter-SFT
- **A Minimalist Approach** (arXiv 2504.11343, 2025) — key_theoretical_support。RAFT 匹配 GRPO/PPO 性能，GRPO 优势主要来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization
- **RS-DPO** (NAACL 2024 Findings) — 系统组合 rejection sampling + DPO，有 threshold/temperature 敏感性 ablation
- **RIFT** (arXiv 2601.09253, 2026) — direct_competitor。指出 RSFT 丢弃负样本的浪费，提出 reward-informed reweighting
- **AdaSTaR** (NeurIPS 2025) — RSFT random sampling 导致训练不平衡，提出 diversity + curriculum sampling，减少 58.6% FLOPs
- **TrajFusion** (arXiv 2602.04391, 2026) — 超越 binary accept/reject，融合部分正确轨迹
- **Rejection Sampling Secretly Performs PPO** (ICML 2025) — RSFT 与 PPO 在 marginal KL 约束下理论等价

**GRPO for IE 相关（7篇核心）：**
- **R1-RE** (arXiv 2507.04642, 2025) — direct_competitor。首个 RLVR (GRPO + verifiable reward) 用于 RE
- **ReasoningNER** (arXiv 2511.11978, 2025) — direct-competitor。GRPO 用于 NER，composite reward
- **EvidenceRL** (arXiv 2603.19532, 2026) — closest_competitor。GRPO 同时优化 grounding + correctness，hallucination 减少 5x
- **E-GRPO** (ICLR 2026) — closest_prior_work。Entity-aware reward 给 near-miss 负样本部分分数
- **GDPO** (ICML 2026) — closest_prior_work。多 reward GRPO 归一化 collapse 问题
- **R2GRPO** (arXiv 2505.22068, 2025) — MimicSFT + relevance/rule-mining reward 用于科学 IE
- **MORE-R1** (arXiv 2603.09478, 2026) — GRPO 用于多模态 RE

**训练动态 / Learning Curve 相关（5篇核心）：**
- **DAPO** (NeurIPS 2025) — entropy collapse 诊断；accuracy=0/1 prompt 产生零梯度
- **Dr. GRPO** (COLM 2025) — std(r)→0 导致 advantage explosion
- **Defeating the Training-Inference Mismatch via FP16** (arXiv 2510.26788, 2025) — BF16 在 150-600 steps 导致 collapse（与你们 GRPO bf16 实验直接相关）
- **RFT Naturally Mitigates Forgetting** (arXiv 2507.05386, 2025) — RFT 梯度被 reward variance 缩放，充当 regularizer
- **R1-RE** — GRPO 训练后 sentence-level RE 无 catastrophic forgetting

| 论文 | Venue/Year | 关键发现 | 是否建议加入 map |
|------|-----------|---------|----------------|
| **RFT (Yuan et al.)** "Scaling Relationship on Learning Mathematical Reasoning" | arXiv 2308.01825, 2023 | rejection sampling 关键因子是 distinct reasoning paths 数量而非仅正确性；LLaMA-7B GSM8K 35.9%→49.3% | **是** — selection quality/diversity 的基础性证据，支撑 CED vs random 实验 |
| **GTPO** "Stabilizing GRPO via Gradient and Entropy Control" | arXiv 2508.03772, 2025 | 解决 GRPO gradient conflicts + policy collapse | 检查是否已在 map — 如无则加入 |
| **GRPO Effective Loss** (arXiv 2503.06639, 2025) | arXiv, 2025 | GRPO 渐近等价于 oracle policy gradient，理论最优性证明 | 检查是否已在 map |
| **Reward-based Input Construction for Cross-doc RE** | arXiv 2405.20649, 2024 | RL 训练 input sentence selection for RE | **是** — RL + RE 的直接先例 |
| **Adaptive RL Planning for Complex IE** | arXiv 2406.11455, 2024 | RL + LLM for IE，address false positives | **是** — RL + LLM IE 的最相关先例 |
| **Hierarchical Framework for RE with RL** (Takanobu et al.) | arXiv 1811.03925, 2018 | 早期 RL for joint entity-relation extraction | 可选 — 经典但较老 |

### 三、与实验结果的文献关联

**Random vs CED RSFT (gap=4.82pp)：**
- literature_map 已覆盖 RSFT 方法论论文（RAFT, AdaSTaR, RIFT），但**缺少 RFT (Yuan et al. 2023) 这篇 selection quality 的基础性实证**。该论文证明 distinct reasoning paths > random sampling，直接支撑 CED scoring 的价值。
- 无论文在 IE 任务上做过 scored vs random ablation — 你们的 4.82pp gap 是该领域的新数据点。

- R1-RE 报告了 GRPO 在 sentence-level RE 上无 catastrophic forgetting，但未报告 learning curve。

- EvidenceRL 是最直接的对比对象（也用 GRPO 优化 evidence grounding）。

### 四、建议

**建议更新 literature_map：**
1. 加入 **RFT (Yuan et al. 2023)** — role: theoretical_support，category: rsft_methodology。selection diversity/quality 的基础性证据。

3. 加入 **Adaptive RL Planning for Complex IE** (2024) — role: related_method，category: rl_for_ie
4. 检查 **GTPO** 和 **GRPO Effective Loss** 是否已在 map 中，如无则补充
